title: WorldDOMINATION Risk Complete Best-Of Graph
description: Complete graph data from the multi-agent code crawl.

nodes.label: worldDOMINATION_EXPO
nodes.description: Latest and strongest repository in the scan. Primary source for the mobile app, Same Time RISK rules, Expo architecture, bundled assets, and persistence.

nodes.label: Expo Mobile App
nodes.description: Primary app implementation under worldDOMINATION_EXPO/artifacts/mobile. It integrates setup, gameplay, records, tournament flows, native storage, map rendering, and the best rules engine.

nodes.label: Same Time RISK Runtime
nodes.description: The most advanced rules/runtime surface in the crawl. It supports simultaneous reinforcement, secret attack orders, battle playback, simultaneous tactical movement, and round resolution.

nodes.label: sameTime.ts Resolver
nodes.description: Pure simultaneous-round resolver for reinforcements, border clashes, mass invasions, surge attacks, tactical moves, and territory state updates.

nodes.label: engine.ts Reducer
nodes.description: Central game reducer and phase machine. It wires classic turns and Same Time RISK into state transitions, logging, cards, elimination, and victory resolution.

nodes.label: Expanded Game Types
nodes.description: State and action model including turn style, Same Time phases, alliances, missions, dice tiers, setup options, battle reports, and tournament data.

nodes.label: AI Generals
nodes.description: Bot decision logic for setup, reinforcement, attack, Same Time orders, movement, and general personality behavior.

nodes.label: 48-Territory Map Model
nodes.description: Territory and continent data for standard and extended maps, including extra territories and Same Time continent bonuses.

nodes.label: Traced Map Shapes
nodes.description: High precision territory outlines used by map rendering and hit testing. Critical for reliable board interaction on mobile and web.

nodes.label: Tiered Dice System
nodes.description: RISK II dice model, including classic battle dice and Same Time army-size tiers with rank-scaled casualties.

nodes.label: Missions and Tournament
nodes.description: Mission deck, objective checks, tournament battle definitions, and scoring helpers for long-form play.

nodes.label: Mobile Game Screen
nodes.description: Full-bleed mobile gameplay screen with map interaction, AI loop, battle scenes, overlays, bottom command panel, rosters, logs, and Same Time playback.

nodes.label: Mobile Setup Screen
nodes.description: Campaign setup UI for players, objectives, allocation, card rules, extended map, turn style, and restricted Same Time reinforcement.

nodes.label: Mobile Command Panel
nodes.description: Phase-aware action panel for deploying, attacking, fortifying, sealing Same Time reinforcements, queuing attack orders, and confirming movement.

nodes.label: Mobile Traced World Board
nodes.description: React Native board renderer combining bundled map art, SVG overlays, shape-based hit testing, sea routes, ownership/threat/strength/empire views, and piece sprites.

nodes.label: Battle and Result Overlays
nodes.description: Handoff, occupy, proposal, victory, dispatch log, stats, and Same Time battle playback overlays.

nodes.label: Bundled Mobile Assets
nodes.description: World map, territory battle views, dice, pieces, fireworks, sound effects, and campaign art bundled for mobile reliability.

nodes.label: Native SQLite Persistence
nodes.description: On-device SQLite repository for autosaves, campaign archive, commander stats, tournament progress, and high scores.

nodes.label: Web Storage Fallback
nodes.description: Expo web fallback repository with the same mobile storage API shape, used when native SQLite is unavailable.

nodes.label: Game Provider Autosave
nodes.description: React context that restores saves, dispatches reducer actions, debounces autosaves, archives completed campaigns, and abandons saves.

nodes.label: Storage API Scaffold
nodes.description: Replit-style API server and object storage scaffold. Useful for future backend storage, but not yet a server-side game engine.

nodes.label: worldDOMINATION_2026 Web
nodes.description: Best web presentation and test-runner donor. It has Vite, React Router, React Query, sql.js/IndexedDB storage, map tests, and browser/unit test scripts, but lacks Same Time runtime integration.

nodes.label: Best Web Presentation
nodes.description: Strongest browser UI reference: full-bleed board, overlays, routes, records, tournament screens, map viewport, and battle presentation.

nodes.label: Vitest Browser Lane
nodes.description: Runnable web testing lane for unit and browser tests in the Vite app. It should receive ported game-rule tests from older sources.

nodes.label: Map Alignment Tests
nodes.description: Existing tests that lock territory anchors to the painted map and verify normalized board coordinates.

nodes.label: worldDOMINATIONweb
nodes.description: Older mixed Expo web plus Swift repository. It is not the best runtime, but it has valuable portable domain tests and historical deployment notes.

nodes.label: Jest Domain Tests
nodes.description: Portable TypeScript domain tests covering setup, allocation, reinforcement, battles, domination, and mission victories.

nodes.label: Legacy SameTimeEngine
nodes.description: Older class-style TypeScript Same Time engine with battle, spoils, and border clash helpers. Useful as a test oracle and historical reference.

nodes.label: Swift RiskConquest Repos
nodes.description: Swift/Xcode-native reference from worldDOMINATION and worldDOMINATION-808. Useful as original behavior provenance and prototype source, not the primary implementation.

nodes.label: Swift Same Time Reference
nodes.description: Original Swift implementation of Same Time planning and battle resolution, including AI order generation and grouped battle resolution.

nodes.label: Swift Rules Tests
nodes.description: Swift rule tests with valuable dice, Same Time, map, mission, card, and campaign feed invariants that should be translated into TypeScript tests.

nodes.label: SceneKit Battle Prototype
nodes.description: Native 3D/prototype battle scene and campaign view code from the Swift repos. Useful for future cinematic ideas, but currently disconnected from the Expo runtime.

nodes.label: worldDOMINATION-React-Native
nodes.description: Private older Expo mobile workspace. Same runtime family as EXPO, but superseded by the newer EXPO repo and missing Same Time TypeScript integration.

nodes.label: wD_google
nodes.description: Private repository that currently contains only the default AI Studio README. It is not a reusable game code source.

nodes.label: Empty Repositories
nodes.description: worldDOMINATION_reactNATIVE and worldDOMINATION_reactnative2026 are cloned but contain no commits or useful source files.

nodes.label: Expo Test Coverage Gap
nodes.description: The strongest Expo mobile repo exposes build/typecheck scripts, but no meaningful automated game-rule test suite yet.

nodes.label: No Server Game Backend
nodes.description: The strongest repo has health/storage API scaffolding only. Multiplayer/auth/server-authoritative game logic is not implemented there.

nodes.label: Best-Of Consolidation Plan
nodes.description: Use EXPO mobile as the source of truth, port web/test assets from worldDOMINATION_2026 and worldDOMINATIONweb, translate Swift tests, and treat old repos as references or retired snapshots.
